items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: This man, Buddy Petit and Punch.

ctx.x: Jazz and shotties and waltz and quadrille. That was their main. You see, at 1130 they start the quadrille. You get your partner and I get mine. I guess you've seen that. Swing around the floor. They call that the quadrille. They used to play the shotties for a prize. The one that dance the levelest and the best got a prize. What kind of prizes would he get? Well, sometimes we laid his parasols and watched.

Now, that's what the people used to be crazy about. The people used to cry out there. But Joe Oliver. He eat us on a condom blue. Oh. Oh, yes. This man, Buddy Petit and Punch. Oh, I'm treated at a good... I have a love now somewhere.

No, Punch is here. He's staying at the Page Hotel. Oh, no. That's right. Oh. Punch is here? Yeah. I almost got arrested with another night. I had a headache so I didn't play. Oh. The judge didn't like it. We were mixing it up, you know. Yeah, I know they don't like it.
